name: DSGC Active Channel Pack
short_description: Vendored 8-channel pack (Nav1.6, NaP, NaR, Kv3, Kv4, BK, SK, Kv7) plus cad calcium pool plus a forked Bed A HOC with un-zeroed CaT/CaL, for active-conductance sweeps on the deposited Poleg-Polsky DSGC (t0008 modeldb_189347_dsgc).

entry_points.name: nav16t74
entry_points.description: Nav1.6 fast transient sodium NEURON SUFFIX (NONSPECIFIC_CURRENT). V_half_act ~ -43 mV, V_half_inact ~ -65 mV. Carter-Bean 2009.

entry_points.name: napt74
entry_points.description: Persistent sodium NEURON SUFFIX (NONSPECIFIC_CURRENT). Single-gate m^1, V_half ~ -50 mV. Magistretti-Alonso 1999.

entry_points.name: nart74
entry_points.description: Resurgent sodium NEURON SUFFIX (NONSPECIFIC_CURRENT). m^3*h*s with slow s gate reactivating around -50 mV. Khaliq 2003.

entry_points.name: kv3t74
entry_points.description: Kv3 fast delayed-rectifier potassium NEURON SUFFIX (NONSPECIFIC_CURRENT). m^4 kinetics, V_half ~ -15 mV. Erisir 1999.

entry_points.name: kv4t74
entry_points.description: Kv4 / IA transient A-type potassium NEURON SUFFIX (NONSPECIFIC_CURRENT). m^4*h, V_half_act ~ -50 mV. Hoffman 1997.

entry_points.name: bk74
entry_points.description: BK / KCa1.1 voltage- and Ca-dependent K channel NEURON SUFFIX (USEION ca READ cai; NONSPECIFIC_CURRENT). V_half ~ -28 mV, K_d = 0.18 uM (Hill exponent 1), Q10 = 2.3. Mainen-Sejnowski 1996 (ModelDB 2488), DOI 10.1038/382363a0.

entry_points.name: sk74
entry_points.description: SK / KCa2 voltage-independent Ca-driven K channel NEURON SUFFIX (USEION ca READ cai; NONSPECIFIC_CURRENT). EC50 = 0.43 uM, Hill = 4.8, tau = 1 ms. Hay 2011 (ModelDB 139653, SK_E2.mod), DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1002107.

entry_points.name: kv7t74
entry_points.description: Kv7 / M-current NEURON SUFFIX (NONSPECIFIC_CURRENT). Adams 1982 alpha/beta formalism, V_half ~ -35 mV, Q10 = 2.3. Hay 2011 (ModelDB 139653, Im.mod), DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1002107.

entry_points.name: cad
entry_points.description: Single-shell calcium pool. depth = 0.1 um, taur = 5 ms, cainf = 2e-4 mM. Destexhe 1995 formalism. Reused verbatim from t0024 de_rosenroll_2026_dsgc library.

entry_points.name: init_active
entry_points.description: Forked HOC procedure that overrides Bed A's init_active to un-zero RGCcaT and RGCcaL (set to 0.0001 S/cm^2) so the cad calcium pool has a current source. Source after build_dsgc() and before init_active is called per trial.

entry_points.name: run_nrnivmodl
entry_points.description: Windows CMD script that compiles the 9 MOD files in code/mods/ into code/build/nrnmech.dll using NEURON's canonical nrnivmodl wrapper.
